title: RUN A STARTUP FOR $20 A MONTH
description:
This is the full stack to run a startup for about $20 a month.
Claude = your coder. $20 a month.
Supabase = your backend. Free.
Vercel = deploying. Free.
Stripe = payments. They only take a cut when you actually get paid.
Clerk = auth. Free. Resend = emails. Free.
PostHog = analytics. Free. Sentry = error tracking. Free.
GitHub and Cloudflare = code and DNS. Free.
Namecheap = your domain. $12 a year.
Ten years ago this exact setup was a funded engineering team.
There has never been a cheaper time to build.
Comment 'radish' for the full list, and save this for the day you stop making excuses.
https://docs.google.com/document/d/12zrr8_r1s_hCf2h3kiVmatkmNyzcuy5ZeSmcfRRKgd4/edit?usp=sharing
